description: Call one Data API by id (from list_data_apis) with params or a short text query. mode direct (default): a ready GET request + extract spec (value, unit, period, geo mapping) so you fetch the source yourself, plus cached rows when cached. mode proxy: we fetch and return compact rows "value unit | period | geo | label" with source and license, within per-source budgets. Free Data APIs cost nothing; paid listed Data APIs answer with an x402 payment requirement. Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...) for per-agent limits.

id.description: Data API id, e.g. worldbank, eurostat, usgs-earthquakes, or a listed id da_...

latest_only.description: Optional: latest period per series only

query.description: Or a short text query, e.g. "GDP Korea 2023" (max 600 chars)

name: call_data_api
